newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Precision limit up on rumour.
newsitem.headline: Kia Precision limit up on rumour.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Kia Precision Works Co went limit-up in early Wednesday afternoon on a market rumour that the country's two carmakers planned to buy stakes of the troubled company, brokers said.
However, a Kia Group spokesman denied the rumour.
Kia Precision rose 670 won to 9,070, which is also the stock's new 1997 high.
"Investors are buying Kia Precision shares on a market rumour that Hyundai and Daewoo plan to buy stakes in the firm," said Choo Hee-yup of Dongwon Securities.
But the Kia spokesman said: "That is not true. There was no talk of such move."
Last week the Kia Group said Hyundai Motor Co and Daewoo Motor Co had agreed in principle to buy stakes in Kia Steel Co.
Both Kia Precision and Kia Steel are units of the Kia Group, which has been put under protection from creditor banks because of financial troubles. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5643
